subject.title: [Refactor] Extract canonical configuration validation from core to plugin boundaries

question: Does current main fully satisfy the intended plugin-owned validation boundary, or is there one specific remaining core-owned schema that should be extracted?
rationale: The repository already documents and implements manifest-owned plugin and channel schemas, while the issue's broader runtime-interrogation design conflicts with current architecture; only a maintainer can confirm whether an intentional residual remains.

options.title: Confirm boundary and close
options.body: Confirm that configSchema, configContracts, and channelConfigs are the canonical boundary and close this issue unless a concrete residual is identified.

options.title: Name a focused residual
options.body: Identify the exact current core symbol and owning plugin, then narrow this issue to extracting that one schema through existing manifest metadata.

options.title: Redesign schema composition
options.body: Sponsor a broader architecture change only if cold manifest metadata is demonstrably insufficient and define the boot and compatibility contract first.

recommendation.title: Confirm boundary and close
recommendation.body: Confirm that configSchema, configContracts, and channelConfigs are the canonical boundary and close this issue unless a concrete residual is identified.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent manifest/configuration boundary history and prior architecture reviews make this person the strongest available routing candidate.
